text:
andrew: Heads up — kicking off a tf apply for tenant-42 routing change in us-west-2. Quiet window starts now. I'll run preflight and then kick deploybot.

sara: copy. what's the change risk? any egress route?

andrew: just adds peering + IAM role binding for svc accounts. low config risk but AZ utilization is high (85-92%).

alia: if AZs are at ~90% i'd prefer a staggered rollout to avoid host packing. suggest serial apply with a 5m pause and health checks.

andrew: agreed. i'll set deploybot flags: --stagger 3 --grace 300s and attach an override for safety.

deploybot: deploybot: preflight complete ✅ plan size=4 resources; changes: 3 add, 1 update. No drift detected. Estimated apply time ~2m per AZ. Proceed? react :eyes: 

tomas: can we pin provider to 4.52.1 for this run? saw provider 4.53 cause a regression last week.

andrew: will pin. adding provider_lock=4.52.1 to the run.

ops-bot: ops-bot: NOTE: recent alert — NAT gateway errors in us-west-2a spiked at 15:42. recommend avoid full traffic shift during apply.

sara: +1 recommend canary peering in us-west-2b first, then shift to 2a only if healthy.

andrew: plan: canary in 2b, wait 10m, check metrics (conn_fail <1%, 5xx no spike), then proceed to 2a. rollback if >1% increase or 5xx spike.

alia: make sure to attach rollout tags and disable autoscale for the affected ASG during apply.

andrew: done. also adding this to release notes: 'tenant-42: routing peering + RBAC for svc accounts; provider pinned to 4.52.1'.

deploybot: deploybot: starting apply in us-west-2b with flags: --stagger=1 --provider=4.52.1 --tag=tenant-42-canary

deploybot: [log] applying module.network.peering.aws_vpc_peering_connection.peering (will be created)
deploybot: [log] apply complete for module.network.peering in us-west-2b — 3 resources added

andrew: apply succeeded in 2b. waiting 10m for metrics — nothing abnormal so far. promoting to 2a in 5m.

(deploybot later) deploybot: starting apply in us-west-2a with flags: --stagger=2 --provider=4.52.1 --tag=tenant-42-rollout

deploybot: [error] aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.rbac_bind: update failed: AccessDenied: User: arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/ops-role/... is not authorized to perform: iam:PassRole on resource: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/peering-setup-role

andrew: ack. rolling back 2a and reverting peering changes in 2a. initiating rollback playbook now.

deploybot: deploybot: rollback initiated — reapplying previous state for module.network.peering in us-west-2a; 2 resources will be removed/rolled back

tomas: log shows missing iam:PassRole in ops-role. i'll open a quick PR to add the permission and ping security for review.

andrew: thanks. i'll pin rollback note to release notes and open an incident for IAM policy gap. Anyone take oncall handoff?

sara: @tomas can you ping security after the PR? :pray:

ops-bot: ops-bot: Rollback complete. All systems nominal. Promotion halted. Please file a postmortem if this impacts customers.

andrew: Filed incident INC-1342 and created a follow-up task: "Add iam:PassRole to ops-role and re-run tenant-42 rollout after QA + security signoff." Will re-run once PR merges and we confirm no drift.

alia: note for next run — add automated IAM permission check in preflight (iam:PassRole test) to avoid manual rollback.

andrew: good call. logging that in the playbook and tagging next deployment window.

sara: thanks all — closing the manual rollout for now. we'll re-schedule after the IAM fix. :white_check_mark:
